# Atlas

A scratch project with enough files for a subagent to survey.
files.maps/north.md: Fjords, glaciers and a lighthouse on every headland.
files.maps/south.md: Salt flats, a railway and two dry lakes.
files.maps/east.md: Rice terraces above a river delta.
files.maps/west.md: Kelp forests off a granite coast.
files.legend/symbols.md: Triangle: summit. Circle: town. Square: harbour.
